parameters.scope: real BGB part of phrase series 04 only; synthetic 04 corpora are not remeasured
parameters.selection: frequent and rare phrase for each length 2..5; two very frequent words with rare phrase; present words in wrong order (k2, k3); one missing word (k3); all from reihe_04_phrasensuche
parameters.schedule: shuffle every (algorithm,query) block per repetition with fixed seed

timer: time.perf_counter_ns; integer elapsed_ns per complete block
background_load: Keine parallelen Messungen, Agenten oder Builds; Videopipeline pausiert; Lastmittel vor Start 1.21 1.64 3.49
cache: same already prepared corpus and checked index reused; no cold-cache claim

timing_boundaries.build: separate complete public inverted/positional index builds on identical prepared documents; validation included; results checked outside timer
timing_boundaries.query: normalize_query(raw,'phrase') plus public phrase kernel and full fresh dict/list of start positions for BOTH methods
timing_boundaries.block: five identical complete calls retained then checked; equal loop/list overhead; destroy results before next timer
timing_boundaries.excluded: loading, preparation, manifest and oracle checks, summaries, output, memory instrumentation

statistics: median, inclusive Q1/Q3 and IQR; block is one sample; quartiles are not confidence intervals

memory.retained_traced_bytes: current_after_build-current_before_build; tracer begins after corpus preparation
memory.limitations: Python-traced additional allocations, not RSS or serialized size; preparation and preexisting independent oracle containers excluded; no simultaneous production alternative index; no profiling times in raw.csv

interpretation_limits: Only the real BGB part is measured; synthetic phrase-length and result-size series of 04 are not remeasured.
Real phrases differ not only in length but also in words, CF/DF, candidate documents and result size; phrase length is not an isolated factor.
Every result contains ALL phrase starts; CSV hit_count counts documents, position_count in metadata counts starts.
One fixed BGB retrieval (2486 paragraphs, 213718 tokens); juridical vocabulary and very unequal document lengths; findings do not generalize to other text types.

source_fixture.independent_tokenizer: run.independent_tokens: NFC, casefold, NFC, regex [^\W_]+ with checks excluding M*/No/Nl; compared with every prepared token sequence
source_fixture.corpus_selection: all paragraphs of the fixed BGB retrieval; one paragraph per document; ID = file name

query_selection.note: Länge 2, beide Wörter sehr häufig, Phrase selten
